descriptionChirho: The abstract act or means of escaping danger, destruction, or captivity; deliverance from peril. Arabic consistently glosses نَجَاة (najah), Korean 피함 (escape-act), Swahili wokovu (salvation/deliverance).

The concrete group of people (or things) that escaped or survived destruction; the remnant that remains after judgment or catastrophe. Includes individual escapees, collective survivors, and construct-state forms indicating the remnant 'of' a particular group.
